race.comment: TEMPRANILLO (15) looks to have found her groove now since joining the QLD stable. Possesses a strong turn of foot, so watch for Thompson to be cold on her early before letting rip. TWISTED QUEEN (7) is a mare in form and finds another suitable mile contest. Drawn a touch sticky but only has to hold her form to be getting involved at the business end. HIGHGROVE ROSE (12) was good first-up when third at Eagle Farm over 1300m but looks much better suited stretching the mile second-up. Expect Maloney to settle back early and save her up for a big crack at them late. Liam Birchley has 9YO THE DRAMATIST (1) back to his best. Lacks early speed but he gets an important 3kg claim and is another that can cause a late scare if the early pace is strong.
